# MF CAS — Usage Guide

*Mode: direct · 🔌 offline (no LLM)*

Reads a detailed, transaction-wise CAMS or KFintech Consolidated Account Statement PDF (the RTA-issued statement listing every purchase, redemption, switch, and reinvestment across your folios) and turns it into three things: a full transactions ledger, a per-folio/scheme holdings view with a units-reconciliation check, and a FIFO-derived realised capital-gains feed -- one row per consumed buy lot, split across multiple lots when a single disposal draws from more than one. Only raw facts are emitted (units, dates, NAVs, cost, proceeds, holding days, gain) -- no tax rate, slab, exemption, indexation, or long/short -term classification is computed; that is left to the ITR Workbook skill's own tax-rules config. A disposal that reaches into units held before the statement's own visible window (a nonzero opening balance with no buy date/cost in this statement) is flagged "unattributed -- review" rather than guessed at, and a buy dated before 2018-02-01 is flagged for the grandfathering FMV your CAS does not itself state.

## When to use it

Use this after receiving your annual (or as-needed) CAS PDF from CAMS or KFintech, when you need a clean realised-capital-gains feed for mutual funds to review or feed manually into the ITR Workbook -- GnuCash books in this codebase hold mutual funds only as cash transfers to the AMC, so there is no commodity-lot data inside GnuCash for capital gains to be derived from automatically.

## Inputs

- **CAMS/KFintech Consolidated Account Statement (PDF)** (required) — accepts: PDF (.pdf) -- one statement, one entity, no multi-select.
  - Your CAMS or KFintech Consolidated Account Statement, as a PDF.
  - ⚠️ Must be the DETAILED, transaction-wise CAS (not the summary-only holdings statement) -- capital gains are derived from the individual transaction rows, not from a pre-computed total.
- **CAS PDF password (usually your PAN in upper case, or date of birth DDMMYYYY)** (optional) — accepts: The statement's open password -- typically your PAN in upper case, or date of birth in DDMMYYYY format.
  - Only needed if the CAS PDF is password-protected (the usual case for CAMS/KFintech emails).
  - ⚠️ Never logged, never included in any error message or output file. Left blank for an unprotected PDF.

## How to run

1. Download your Consolidated Account Statement (detailed, transaction-wise) from CAMS or KFintech.
2. Pick the PDF and, if it is password-protected, enter its password.
3. Click Run.
4. Download the workbook and review the Exceptions sheet first.

## Output

Output is written to the **`Data/outputs/`** folder, named:

```
Data/outputs/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-<input>-MF-CAS.xlsx
```

Files produced:

- **`YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-<input>-MF-CAS.xlsx`** — Four sheets: Transactions (every parsed row), Holdings (per folio/scheme opening/closing units and reconciliation OK/BREACH), RealisedGains (one row per consumed FIFO lot -- raw facts only), and Exceptions (every flagged item collected in one place).
- **`YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-<input>-MF-CAS_transactions.csv`** — CSV sibling of the Transactions sheet.
- **`YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-<input>-MF-CAS_realised_gains.csv`** — CSV sibling of the RealisedGains sheet.

## Tips

Start with the Exceptions sheet -- it collects every units-reconciliation breach, unattributed disposal, grandfathering flag, and RTA-realised-gain variance in one place. A nonzero Opening Unit Balance on a folio (units held before the statement's own window) will produce at least one "unattributed -- review" lot the first time that folio's units are ever sold within the statement -- this is expected, not a bug, and means the buy date/cost for that portion must be sourced from an earlier statement.

## Troubleshooting

| If… | Then… |
|------|-------|
| 'PDF is password-protected' error. | Enter the CAS delivery password -- typically your PAN in upper case, or date of birth DDMMYYYY. |
| 'No text could be extracted from this PDF.' | The statement is likely a scanned/image-only PDF; OCR is not supported in this skill's v1. Request a text-based CAS from CAMS/KFintech instead. |
| 'No folio/scheme blocks were recognised.' | The PDF's text was extracted but did not match this skill's expected CAS layout. Confirm it is the DETAILED, transaction-wise statement, not a summary. |
| A scheme shows a units-reconciliation BREACH. | Opening + acquisitions - disposals did not match the statement's own closing balance within tolerance. Check the Exceptions sheet for the exact numbers, and re-check the statement for a corporate action (merger/split) this v1 does not model. |
